Automate the guest through the host display.

```text
pomme ui SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme ui type

Type text into the guest display.

```text
pomme ui type [--vm VM] [--text TEXT] [--text-env TEXT_ENV] [--replace] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--vm VM` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |
| `--text TEXT` | Text to type. |
| `--text-env TEXT_ENV` | Environment variable containing text to type. |
| `--replace` | Press Command-A before typing so the text replaces the focused field's contents. Off by default. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui key

Press a guest key.

```text
pomme ui key [--vm VM] --key KEY [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--vm VM` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |
| `--key KEY` | Key name, such as return or cmd-shift-t. Run `pomme ui keys` for the names. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui key-sequence

Press a sequence of guest keys.

```text
pomme ui key-sequence [--vm VM] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS] -- [KEYS ...]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `KEYS` | Key names after --, pressed in order. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--vm VM` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui keys

List the key names accepted by ui key and ui key-sequence.

```text
pomme ui keys [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui click

Click guest display coordinates.

```text
pomme ui click [--vm VM] --x X --y Y [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--vm VM` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |
| `--x X` | Display x coordinate in points, from the left edge. |
| `--y Y` | Display y coordinate in points, from the top edge. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui screenshot

Capture the guest display.

```text
pomme ui screenshot [--vm VM] --output OUTPUT [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--vm VM` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |
| `--output OUTPUT` | Host output file path. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
